title: Austin meeting where Puthoff said Skinwalker Ranch needed a SCIF
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Austin meeting where Puthoff said Skinwalker Ranch needed a SCIF, about a few years ago (TTSA era) at Texas (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then Hal finally looked around and said, "Well, we need a skiff for this one."

plain: A writer named Peter Levenda, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he was at a meeting in Austin, Texas, with a group that included Tom DeLonge, Chris Mellon, Hal Puthoff, Jacques Vallee and John Alexander, where the talk turned to Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings. Levenda says Puthoff finally looked around and said they would need a SCIF, a specially secured room for classified discussions, for this one, which would suggest that what was known about the ranch was too sensitive to say out loud.
